faq.section_description: Everything you need to know about Akeed and our services. If you can't find your answer here, contact us directly!
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

integration.question: How does it integrate with my store?
integration.answer: We integrate with all popular platforms: Shopify, WooCommerce, Zid, Salla, and others. Setup takes only 5 minutes via a simple Webhook.

whatsapp.question: Do I need a special WhatsApp number?
whatsapp.answer: Yes, you need a WhatsApp Business number. We help you with setup and connecting to WhatsApp Business API completely.

arabic.question: Does the bot understand Arabic well?
arabic.answer: Yes! The bot is specially trained on Egyptian dialect and Modern Standard Arabic. It understands different replies like 'tamam', 'mashi', 'mowafek', 'la shukran' and others.

pricing.question: What happens if I exceed the confirmation limit?
pricing.answer: In the Professional plan, each additional confirmation is only 0.70 EGP. In the Starter plan, you can upgrade anytime.

whatsapp_api.question: Do I need an expensive WhatsApp Business API?
whatsapp_api.answer: Akeed offers you easy and affordable integration options, whether you want to use your own number or benefit from our solutions.

unconfirmed_order.question: What if the customer doesn't confirm the order or send their location?
unconfirmed_order.answer: Akeed immediately marks the order as 'Unconfirmed' in your store, so you don't ship it and save your money.

easy_integration.question: Is integration with my store difficult?
easy_integration.answer: Not at all! Akeed provides you with a simple step-by-step video guide to connect your store in less than a minute. It's just an API Key or a simple plugin.

customize_messages.question: Can I customize Akeed's messages and language?
customize_messages.answer: Absolutely, you can choose the dialect that fits your brand (colloquial, formal, Franco) and edit the messages as you like.

roi_calculator.section_title: Calculate for yourself... How much can Akeed save you monthly?

legal.termsIntro: By using Akeed, you agree to the following terms and conditions.
legal.termsSection1Body: Akeed provides automated WhatsApp-based order verification for e-commerce stores operating with cash-on-delivery payment models.
legal.termsSection2Body: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials and for all activity that occurs under your account.
legal.termsSection3Body: We process order and customer data solely for the purpose of providing verification services. See our Privacy Policy for details.
legal.termsSection4Body: Akeed is provided on an "as-is" basis. We do not guarantee uninterrupted service and are not liable for indirect damages arising from use of the service.
legal.termsSection5Body: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
legal.privacyIntro: This policy explains how Akeed collects, uses, and protects your data.
legal.privacySection1Body: We collect account information (email, name, company), store data (orders, customer details for verification), and usage data (access logs, feature usage).
legal.privacySection2Body: Your data is used to provide order verification services, improve our platform, and communicate service updates. We do not sell your data to third parties.
legal.privacySection3Body: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. You may request deletion of your data at any time by contacting support.
legal.privacySection4Body: We use industry-standard encryption and security practices to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.
legal.privacySection5Body: For privacy-related inquiries, contact us at support@akeed.app.
